title: OpenApps leaderboard submission meta.yaml
description: Who ran what, when. Hand-written; `uv run -m open_apps.leaderboard.pack` fills it from the run configs.

model.description: The model the agent ran (agent config model_name).

date.description: ISO date the bundle was packed.

contact.description: How maintainers reach the submitter (GitHub handle or email).

agent_config_hash.description: sha256 prefix of agent.yaml with every secret-looking value normalized to <redacted> (open_apps.leaderboard.bundle.normalized_agent_hash). Every record's identity.agent_config_hash must equal it.

redacted.description: agent.yaml keys whose values were replaced before committing.

wandb_report.description: Optional public W&B report URL. An ingestion aid, never the source of truth.

verified.description: Deprecated: absent or false. Verification is recorded by maintainers in leaderboard/verifications.yaml (uv run -m open_apps.leaderboard.verify record), never in a bundle.
